name: Cantorate Hull Blueprints
desc: The Cantorate's hull scores: growth and calibration protocols for the lattice cores of its line ships, with the frames written around them. Enables heavy industry to construct Lattice hulls.

name: Cantorate Weapon Blueprints
desc: Rail, lance and spike patterns tuned to lattice cores. Enables heavy industry to construct the Cantorate's weapons.

name: Cantorate Wing Blueprints
desc: Fighter LPCs for the Cantorate's tuned wings. Enables heavy industry to construct Lattice fighters.
